# Code Anchors: Ephemeral Hand-Off Entry

- `.gitignore` — the ignore rule that makes the hand-off area version-ignored, so nothing written there can be committed or carry a committed deletion.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — an issue-sourced local close resolves the epic into the ephemeral area and writes its close record there as hand-off content, never committed and never described as committed.
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — the contractual receipt placement: beside the materialized epic in the ephemeral area for an issue-sourced epic, the committed entry for an old-contract one, no file at all in pull-request mode; the gate runs only for an epic entry, naming the recorded kind of any other.
- `components/commands/nxs.distill.md` — discovery of ephemeral entries of all three kinds, the close-record-required drainability test, the kind-over-directory-name authority and its named mismatch block, consumption derived from the trunk store's structured provenance, the two-test merge precondition, exclusion from drain-health accounting, and the removal re-aimed at the committed scratch dir or absent entirely.
- `components/skills/nxs-landed-reference/SKILL.md` — states that the epic kind records no kind at all, so a missing recorded kind under an epic-named directory reads as epic, and that an entry whose reference cannot be read still holds its number (#549)
- `components/commands/nxs.fix.md` — the second writer into this area, which names the entry by its number and records its kind in the header (#549)
- `components/commands/nxs.intake.md` — the third writer into this area, naming the entry by its pull-request number and recording its kind in the header (#549)
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/render.ts` — the resolver that materializes an epic into this area; its epic-only output is scratch, not a drainable entry, and it records no kind.
